Ben/Karthik,

Quick draft language below for the termination carve-out Novella requested. This is intentionally narrow and tied to regulator subpoenas or legally compelled audits: 

"Termination Access for Regulatory Review. In the event Customer receives a legally compelled request from a governmental or regulatory authority requiring access to Customers data or operational artifacts hosted under this Agreement, Customer may request from Redwood a one-time, time-limited access window not to exceed fourteen (14) calendar days (the \"Access Window\"). During the Access Window Redwood will provide Customer with read-only access to the minimal set of artifacts reasonably required for the regulatory review, subject to two-person operational approval and Redwoods standard data egress controls. All access will be logged, encrypted in transit, and a chain-of-custody report will be provided within five (5) business days following the Access Window. Any further access must be approved in writing by Redwood and is subject to standard commercial terms."

Notes / asks for Karthik: please confirm the 14-day ceiling and whether we need to insert explicit language about KMS key escrow or transfer mechanics. For evidence staging, I suggest the following items be included in the binder: snapshot(s) (WORM copy), operator runbook excerpt, notarized operator-attestation PDF, audit logs for the window, and a signed transfer receipt. Ill attach a two-page evidence handoff plan.

If were good on this, Ben — we should turn that into a tracked redline and share alongside a short timeline: staging prep (7 business days), transfer + verification (3 business days), binder closeout (2 business days).

Laura Bennett

Operational timeline note: engineering needs a 7-business-day lead to stage and validate the encrypted snapshot and a further 3 days for verification and notarization. That aligns with Lauras proposal.
